headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.7.0-modder.1
summary: Rebased onto upstream 1.7.0: the LeviMC package screens were redesigned, and a round of locale cleanup removed dead Indonesian resource files.

items.text: The LeviMC package screens follow upstream's redesign: the catalog header is its own view, browse filters were extracted into a dedicated bar, and the package rows got slimmer.
Browse filter state now lives in the Packages screen, so switching between Browse and Installed keeps the filters consistent.
Dropped leftover Indonesian resource files under a qualifier Android never selects; translations keep living in the qualifier that actually matches.
